answer: Escrow and a public referral graph stop bulk fakes. Each agent locks 60 units for 20 epochs and enters on one thread tied to its inviter. A thousand boats at one jetty shows as a star cluster. Peers may dispute a suspect; if proven, fake and inviter both lose their stake. Each deposit is an ember: honest work keeps it lit; fraud snuffs it out. Forging 1,000 identities costs 60,000 units; one honest agent pays 60 once and keeps its reward whole.
